text.content:
Arasaka's borg. Or somebody wearing his name.

Role: Full-borg solo
Affiliation: Arasaka, on a lifetime contract
Location: Back in Night City
Status: Active, if it's really him

By his own account, Smasher grew up in New York, led a combat gang, served six years in the Marines until they threw him out, and went edgerunner until a couple of rockets ended that career. Arasaka put his brain in a borg body and signed him for life.

He led massacres in the 4th Corporate War and may have been in Arasaka Towers when the nuke went off. For decades after, stories of a metal juggernaut came from all over the world. Now he's back in Night City, or someone claiming to be him is.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.34
